Composition: A well-built wooden table has sturdy legs, sound joints and diagonal braces and comfortably supports several heavy boxes. Show its solid construction rather than a muscular person or a damaged table.

Style: Use invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown contours, rounded forms and restrained 2D shading.

Framing: One compact composition, complete subjects filling 80-90% of the square with safe margins.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No unrelated text, labels, logos or watermark.
Use the reference only for illustration style. Complete naturally connected bodies, normal arm lengths, exactly two arms and two hands per person. Keep main subjects and all extremities inside frame. No floating torsos. Transparent background.
For tables and counters, show the full furniture legs and person's connected legs and shoes underneath; never terminate torso at tabletop. Show every audience member's full connected lower body.

sense.en: any of several swift African mammals (Equus grevyi, E. quagga, and E. zebra) related to the horse but distinctively and conspicuously patterned in stripes of black or dark brown and white or buff

scene.en: A zebra stands on four hooves, showing black-and-white stripes and a short upright mane.
scene.ja: シマウマが4本の脚で立ち、白黒の縞模様と短い立ちたてがみを見せています。

review.method: Visual inspection of saved PNG on white, navy and pink backgrounds; adopted PNG SHA256 and Git blob verified.
review.notes: 完成PNGを白・濃紺・ピンク背景で開き、語義・人体・輪郭・透過を確認。
